title: Report: Broncos are seeking a tight end trade, Cardinals rebuffed request for Trey McBride

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Report: Broncos are seeking a tight end trade, Cardinals rebuffed request for Trey McBride
sources.description: Denver would like to acquire a veteran tight end before Tuesday's trade deadline, but that tight end will apparently not be Arizona's Trey McBride.
